title: Cloudflare Blog
description: Technical deep dives, product updates, and insights from the teams that are helping to build a better Internet.

items.title: Yandex outage: Data shows that instead of going dark, malicious bots went on the move
items.content: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.
items.contentSnippet: When strikes hit Yandex data centers, many assumed Russian bot operations went dark. Cloudflare data reveals that while search crawling stopped, malicious bots simply migrated to other networks.
items.creator: Marina Elmore

items.title: Inside Hyperdrive: How we solved a rare Hyperdrive MySQL caching bug
items.content: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available.
items.contentSnippet: While adding MySQL support to Hyperdrive, we found a subtle protocol bug when caching query results. Here is how we tracked down a 0.001% rate error and made Hyperdrive MySQL generally available.
items.creator: Pranoy Dutta

items.title: Under the hood, off the hot path: How D1 scales to millions of databases
items.content: A deep dive into how D1 architected its control plane to scale and manage millions of databases, while keeping data plane query operations at the edge. We share guiding principles on how to build on the Developer Platform effectively.

items.title: Filter, reshape, and redact logs before export with Transformers
items.content: Logpush now supports Transformers, allowing teams to filter, redact, and reshape log streams using SQL before export. Powered by Apache DataFusion and Apache Arrow, Transformers apply those changes directly to log data before it reaches the destination.

items.creator: Rob Taylor

items.title: Introducing Clef-omni with full multimodality, plus a faster Clef and a cheaper Clef-flash
items.content: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline. We’ve also lowered Clef-flash pricing and boosted Clef inference speeds by up to 2.0x.
items.contentSnippet: We are expanding the Clef decision model family with Clef-omni, natively processing audio, video, images, and text in a single pipeline. We’ve also lowered Clef-flash pricing and boosted Clef inference speeds by up to 2.0x.
items.creator: Michelle Chen

items.title: Introducing on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs for Workers and Durable Objects
items.content: On-demand CPU and memory profiling for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects is now available. Now you can generate interactive flamegraphs directly in production to quickly track down memory leaks and performance bottlenecks.

items.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
items.content: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.
